§16-26 Questionable ballots. A ballot
shall be questionable if:

(1) The ballot contains any mark or symbol whereby it
can be identified, or any mark or symbol contrary to the provisions of law; or

(2) Two or more ballots are found in the ballot box
so folded together as to make it clearly evident that more than one ballot was
put in by one person, the ballots shall be set aside as provided below.

Each ballot that is held to be questionable
shall be endorsed on the back by a voter service center official with the
official's name or initials, and the word "questionable". All
questionable ballots shall be set aside uncounted and disposed of as provided
for ballots in section 11-154. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2; am L 1973, c 217,
§6(d); gen ch 1985, 1993; am L 2021, c 213, §41]
